tasks.label: conda-build: current recipe
args: source "$(conda info --base)/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" && conda activate conda-lab-build && recipe_dir="${fileDirname}" && while [ "$recipe_dir" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$recipe_dir/meta.yaml" ]; do recipe_dir="$(dirname "$recipe_dir")"; done && if [ ! -f "$recipe_dir/meta.yaml" ]; then echo 'No meta.yaml found upward from ${file}'; exit 1; fi && echo "Building recipe at $recipe_dir" && conda build "$recipe_dir"

tasks.label: conda: build hello-python
tasks.command: source "$(conda info --base)/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" && conda activate conda-lab-build && conda build recipes/hello-python/
